name: facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former_video/data_video/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.build_augmentation: build a list of image augmentation transforms from a detectron2 config for training or testing
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.create_ResizeShortestEdge: create a ResizeShortestEdge augmentation that scales the shorter edge with clip-aware frame counting
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.create_RandomFlip: create a RandomFlip augmentation that flips images horizontally or vertically with clip-aware frame counting
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.review_ResizeShortestEdge_get_transform: review the ResizeShortestEdge get_transform method that computes scale and returns a ResizeTransform
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.review_RandomFlip_get_transform: review the RandomFlip get_transform method that returns HFlipTransform, VFlipTransform, or NoOpTransform

facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.build_detection_train_loader: build a detection training data loader with dataset, mapper, sampler, and batch size from config
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.build_detection_test_loader: build a detection test data loader with batch size 1 for inference evaluation
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.get_detection_dataset_dicts: load and prepare dataset dicts for instance detection and semantic segmentation from dataset names
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.filter_images_with_only_crowd_annotation: filter out images with only crowd annotations from a list of dataset dicts
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.compute_num_images_per_worker: compute the number of images per worker from the solver batch size and world size

facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.build_YTVISDatasetMapper: build a YTVISDatasetMapper to map YouTube-VIS dataset dicts into model input format with frame sampling
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.build_CocoClipDatasetMapper: build a CocoClipDatasetMapper to convert COCO images into multi-frame model input format
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.filter_empty_instances: filter empty instances from an Instances object by box size or mask emptiness
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.convert_ytvis_annotations_to_instances: convert YouTube-VIS annotation dicts into a detectron2 Instances object with boxes, classes, ids, and masks
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.review_YTVISDatasetMapper_call: review the YTVISDatasetMapper call method for frame sampling, augmentation, and instance annotation transformation logic

facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.create_YTVISEvaluator: create a YTVISEvaluator instance to evaluate video instance segmentation predictions on a YTVIS dataset
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.run_YTVISEvaluator_evaluate: run the YTVISEvaluator evaluate method to compute AP and AR metrics on collected predictions
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.process_YTVISEvaluator_predictions: process model inputs and outputs through YTVISEvaluator to accumulate video segmentation predictions
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.convert_instances_to_coco_json_video: convert video model outputs with scores, labels, and masks into YTVIS COCO JSON format
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.run_evaluate_predictions_on_coco: run COCO evaluation on YTVIS predictions using YTVOSeval to compute segmentation AP metrics
